mapper.select: select organization_code from evaluation_organization_mappings where user_id=#{userId} and business_type='FACULTY_ACHIEVEMENT' order by case data_scope when 'SELF' then 0 when 'DEPARTMENT' then 1 when 'COLLEGE' then 2 when 'BUSINESS' then 3 else 4 end, mapping_id limit 1
mapper.sql: from lecture_evaluation_achievements a join users u on u.user_id=a.teacher_user_id left join korus_personnel_snapshots p on p.employee_no=u.employee_no where a.deleted_at is null and (a.teacher_user_id=#{userId} or exists (select 1 from evaluation_organization_mappings m where m.user_id=#{userId} and m.business_type='FACULTY_ACHIEVEMENT' and m.organization_code=a.organization_code and m.data_scope in ('DEPARTMENT','COLLEGE','BUSINESS','ALL'))) and a.management_no ilike concat('%',#{criteria.managementNo},'%') and p.name ilike concat('%',#{criteria.teacherName},'%') and a.management_item_code=#{criteria.managementItemCode} and a.achievement_date >= #{criteria.occurredDateFrom} and a.achievement_date <= #{criteria.occurredDateTo} and a.achievement_status=#{criteria.certificationStatus}
mapper.select: select a.achievement_id as "achievementId",a.management_no as "managementNo",a.evaluation_year as "evaluationYear",a.organization_code as "organizationCode",a.teacher_user_id as "teacherUserId",p.name as "teacherName",a.management_item_code as "managementItemCode",a.achievement_date as "occurredDate",a.achievement_status as "certificationStatus",a.detail_payload::text as "achievementDetail",a.attachment_count as "attachmentCount",(a.occurrence_date_warning_yn='Y') as "occurrenceDateWarning" order by a.achievement_date desc,a.achievement_id desc limit #{criteria.pageSize} offset #{criteria.page} * #{criteria.pageSize}

select a.achievement_id as "achievementId",a.management_no as "managementNo",a.evaluation_year as "evaluationYear",a.organization_code as "organizationCode",a.teacher_user_id as "teacherUserId",p.name as "teacherName",a.management_item_code as "managementItemCode",a.achievement_date as "occurredDate",a.achievement_status as "certificationStatus",a.detail_payload::text as "achievementDetail",a.attachment_count as "attachmentCount",(a.occurrence_date_warning_yn='Y') as "occurrenceDateWarning" from lecture_evaluation_achievements a join users u on u.user_id=a.teacher_user_id left join korus_personnel_snapshots p on p.employee_no=u.employee_no where a.achievement_id=#{achievementId} and a.deleted_at is null
mapper.insert: insert into lecture_evaluation_achievements(management_no,evaluation_year,organization_code,teacher_user_id,management_item_code,achievement_date,achievement_status,detail_payload,attachment_count,occurrence_date_warning_yn,created_by,updated_by,change_reason) values(#{managementNo},#{evaluationYear},#{organizationCode},#{teacherUserId},#{managementItemCode},#{occurredDate},#{certificationStatus},cast(#{achievementDetail} as jsonb),#{attachmentCount},case when #{occurrenceDateWarning} then 'Y' else 'N' end,#{teacherUserId},#{teacherUserId},'강의평가 실적 저장')
mapper.update: update lecture_evaluation_achievements set management_item_code=#{managementItemCode},achievement_date=#{occurredDate},achievement_status=#{certificationStatus},detail_payload=cast(#{achievementDetail} as jsonb),attachment_count=#{attachmentCount},occurrence_date_warning_yn=case when #{occurrenceDateWarning} then 'Y' else 'N' end,updated_at=current_timestamp,updated_by=#{teacherUserId} where achievement_id=#{achievementId}
mapper.select: select #{userId}=#{ownerUserId} or exists(select 1 from evaluation_organization_mappings where user_id=#{userId} and organization_code=#{organizationCode} and business_type='FACULTY_ACHIEVEMENT')

select exists(select 1 from input_period_settings where evaluation_year=#{evaluationYear} and organization_code=#{organizationCode} and area_code='EDUCATION' and active_yn='Y' and #{checkedAt} between start_at and end_at)
select exists(select 1 from evaluation_result_locks where evaluation_year=#{evaluationYear} and organization_code=#{organizationCode} and confirmation_status='CONFIRMED')

select exists(select 1 from evaluation_date_settings where evaluation_year=#{evaluationYear} and organization_code=#{organizationCode} and area_code='EDUCATION' and active_yn='Y' and #{occurrenceDate} between start_at::date and end_at::date)
